rulings.restated: (helper "Unrecaptured section 1250 gain, box 2b" > sd helper "Capital gain distributions, generally Form 1099-DIV box 2a" or helper "Section 1202 gain, box 2c" > sd helper "Capital gain distributions, generally Form 1099-DIV box 2a" or helper "Collectibles (28%) gain, box 2d" > sd helper "Capital gain distributions, generally Form 1099-DIV box 2a" or helper "Total special capital-gain distribution components" > sd helper "Capital gain distributions, generally Form 1099-DIV box 2a")
rulings.model: The text supports each check on its own, since boxes 2b, 2c and 2d are each "the portion of the amount in box 2a". The text never says these portions are disjoint, so it does not establish that their sum cannot exceed box 2a.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: ambiguity; amb.2025.div_gain_portions_disjoint (linked to div.bad_special by the p4-docs package). f1099div p. 5, Instructions for Recipient: "Box 2b. Shows the portion of the amount in box 2a that is unrecaptured section 1250 gain", "Box 2c. Shows the portion of the amount in box 2a that is section 1202 gain", "Box 2d. Shows the portion of the amount in box 2a that is 28% rate gain". The model accepts each single-box test and objects only that the text does not say the portions are disjoint, so the sum test is not established. That is the register's text at issue; the register chooses the first reading (the portions are disjoint, so their sum cannot exceed box 2a) because each box is a different kind of property (section 1250 real property, section 1202 small business stock, collectibles). Why the line is new to the open list: the restatement and the cited text are unchanged; the previous reviewer judged it MATCH. Project stands.
